title: A fictional role should not rewrite the operator.
evidence_label: Twelve existing offline Python tests passed using isolated SQLite state.

execution_scope.storage: In-memory SQLite and isolated temporary SQLite databases
execution_scope.identity: Fixed-identity test double for API checks
execution_scope.implementation: Real staging, memory derivation and review functions

illustrative_content.line: I will bring the blue folder.

assertions.result: The two-character test selects each character in turn. All events from that turn belong to the selected collection, not the other character or operator collection.

assertions.case: Role is part of request identity
assertions.result: The selected role is persisted. The same key and role returns the original staged row; the same key with a different role conflicts.
The operator binding and a binding outside the scene are refused.
Derivation creates no events rather than using a different participant or operator collection.
assertions.scope: Missing collection; not arbitrary storage-failure recovery.

assertions.result: After a manual scene, API close and review decisions accepting story while rejecting mind and world, operator profile and memory-event-set hashes remain equal. No operator events or participant-state rows are added; character events exist in the character collection.
assertions.scope: API decisions do not demonstrate a scene-close UI or applying canon in another product.

assertions.result: Changing the operator profile name changes its hash; adding an operator memory event changes the event-set hash.

ui_source_inspection.behavior: Role controls lock while a stage request is in flight or a turn is pending; the UI explains the lock. Provisional content is visually separate from accepted history.
ui_source_inspection.evidence: Existing implementation and component-test assertions inspected.

tradeoffs: Changing role requires finishing or abandoning the pending attempt rather than toggling the identity of that attempt.
A missing selected collection produces no derived memory; this protects attribution without repairing the missing destination.
claim_limits: Related checks are explained with newly authored fiction, not one captured product workflow.
Pending memory is not approved memory, psychological truth or a measure of recall quality.
The inspected UI has no scene-close review screen.
SQLite and fixed-identity tests do not establish PostgreSQL contention or production authentication.
No models, live service integration, deployment, browser interaction or long-horizon relationship quality were tested in this selection.
The project is personally directed and AI-assisted; the evidence does not establish sole personal implementation authorship.
Private application source, internal links, personal profiles, memory exports and private story material are excluded.
